title: DbDataBuild model definition
description: A model definition file (models/**/<name>.yml), the companion of the plain DuckDB-dialect <name>.sql body. This schema is for editors; `dbdatabuild validate` applies the same rules plus semantic checks (name against path, grain against unique_key, column references) with diagnostic codes. The tool reads every scalar as a string, so values here that YAML would type (nullable) accept the quoted and unquoted forms.

name.description: Schema-qualified model name. Must equal the path under models/ with '/' replaced by '.' (models/marts/fct_orders.yml is marts.fct_orders).

grain.description: Columns that uniquely identify an output row. Required for incremental kinds; for incremental_by_unique_key it must equal unique_key.

targets.description: Engines the model must be valid for. The project's default_targets apply if omitted.

columns.description: The declared output schema. Required for every model: it drives the shape hash, the plan's DDL, and offline validation.

renames.description: Declared column renames. Renames are never inferred.

loads.description: Named load operations (DESIGN.md 6.6). Without `loads`, the kind supplies a single operation named `default`: full_replace for full, delete_insert_by_key for incremental_by_unique_key, and a watermark load over the time column for incremental_by_time_range. A view has no loads. Declared operations replace the implicit one. At most one operation per target may be the default.

allOf.description: A view has no data load.

kind.description: Table semantics, and the default load operation.

oneOf.title: view
oneOf.description: View over upstream. DDL only; apply issues no data statements.

oneOf.title: full
oneOf.description: Table fully reloaded: transactional delete and insert.

oneOf.title: incremental_by_time_range
oneOf.description: Time-sliced incremental. The range comes from MAX(time_column) in the target minus lookback. Requires time_column.

lookback.description: For example `3 days` (minutes, hours, days, weeks or months; a DATE column takes days, weeks or months).

type.description: A SQL type written as a plain string, for example `BIGINT` or `DECIMAL(14, 2)`.

collation.description: Logical collation name from the project's string_semantics.collations. The project default applies if omitted.

oneOf.title: full_replace
oneOf.description: Delete and insert the whole contents in one transaction.

default.description: The operation `run` uses when `--op` is not given. At most one per target.

targets.description: Restrict the operation to these targets. Without it the operation applies to every target the model declares.

oneOf.title: delete_insert_by_key
oneOf.description: Stage the query result, delete target rows whose key is in it, insert it. One transaction.

default.description: The operation `run` uses when `--op` is not given. At most one per target.

targets.description: Restrict the operation to these targets. Without it the operation applies to every target the model declares.

key.description: Key columns. Defaults to the kind's unique_key.

oneOf.title: merge_by_key
oneOf.description: Stage the query result and MERGE it by key (update matches, insert the rest). One transaction.

default.description: The operation `run` uses when `--op` is not given. At most one per target.

targets.description: Restrict the operation to these targets. Without it the operation applies to every target the model declares.

key.description: Key columns. Defaults to the kind's unique_key.

oneOf.title: delete_insert_by_range
oneOf.description: Reload a range [start, end) of the range column: delete it in the target and insert the query's rows for it. `start` and `end` are runtime parameters.

default.description: The operation `run` uses when `--op` is not given. At most one per target.

targets.description: Restrict the operation to these targets. Without it the operation applies to every target the model declares.

column.description: The range column. Defaults to the kind's time_column.

params.description: Types of the `start` and `end` parameters; they must match the range column. Defaults to the column's type.

max_span.description: The longest range one run may reload, for example `400 days`. Enforced at plan time.

oneOf.title: watermark_append
oneOf.description: Load rows newer than a watermark read from the target (never from a state table). With a lookback, rows in the lookback window are replaced, never duplicated.

default.description: The operation `run` uses when `--op` is not given. At most one per target.

targets.description: Restrict the operation to these targets. Without it the operation applies to every target the model declares.

resolver.description: How the watermark is determined. Rendered and committed.

lookback.description: Re-read this far before the watermark, for example `3 days`.

on_null.description: What an empty target means. `require_param` asks for a value; `initial` uses the committed literal. Default: require_param.

initial.description: The committed literal used when `on_null: initial` and the target is empty.

overridable.description: Allow an explicit `--param watermark=...`, recorded in the plan as an override. Default: false.
